question: Does F1 keep the EXACT canonical A8 routing membership and change only the regional-refiner input?
clean_one_factor_interpretation: YES_IF_PHYSICALLY_SUPPORTED — keeping identical router scores/membership and changing only the refiner input is the cleanest one-factor interpretation.
physical_support_in_frozen_plan: ABSENT — the frozen Phase24 ablation plan defines F1 as 'refiner without p_global channel' but does NOT state whether the routing membership is held identical to the canonical A8 membership or recomputed.
would_rerouting_be_required: If router runtime uses delta_hat_final from B_phi (unchanged), membership is machine-identical; but the frozen plan does not state that F1 is evaluated on the same activation set. This must be explicitly established.
